ConfigEntry.description:
One setting: its effective value and the layer it came from. A secret has no `value`: it lives in the OS
keychain, and no method returns it (0.7, Secrets). `overridden` is what the effective value replaced, when a
layer that sets the key was passed over (never for a secret). `is_set` is for a secret only: whether the keychain
holds an item for it.

OverriddenValue.description: A value a higher layer replaced: what the layer below it said (the Settings page shows it struck out).

SettingLayer.description: The layer a setting's value came from, lowest first (0.7, Values come from four layers).

oneOf.description: The schema's defaults, and the built-in agent entry.
The run's profile, the top layer.

description: `config.set` result: the setting after the write, so a repo value that shadows the user's is shown as the repo's.
title: ConfigSetResult
